claim: Source research was performed for the paper_auto candidate using Alpaca OPG/LOO order documentation and SEC leveraged ETF risk guidance inherited from the source strategy review.
impact_on_spec: Candidate execution policy uses LOO/OPG price-protected opening orders, gap/spread filters, and paper-only broker scope.
limitations: Paper fills may not match live exchange auction behavior; paper_auto remains blocked until explicit activation approval and account snapshot review.

claim: Source research was performed for daily open execution, Alpaca paper/order support, and leveraged ETF risk domains before promotion or paper readiness.
impact_on_spec: Execution policy must compare open execution styles and should prefer price-protected opening orders or delayed-open fallbacks before paper_auto.
limitations: Alpaca documentation describes supported order semantics; paper fills may not replicate live exchange auction behavior.

claim: Alpaca supports time_in_force=opg with market or limit equity orders for market-on-open and limit-on-open orders; unfilled opening-auction orders are canceled after the open.
impact_on_spec: Execution policy may compare opg_limit/loo_limit against day_market or delayed_open_5m for next-open daily strategies.
limitations: The docs note cutoff and routing behavior; broker paper execution can differ from exchange auction fills.

claim: Alpaca states OPG orders submitted after 9:28am and before 7:00pm ET are rejected, while OPG orders submitted after 7:00pm are queued for the next opening auction.
impact_on_spec: Paper order window should be before the opening-auction cutoff or use an explicit delayed-open fallback instead of assuming all next-open orders are accepted.
limitations: Cutoff handling can vary by venue and order eligibility; execution policy should log submitted_at and order status.

claim: Alpaca documentation lists OPG as unavailable for fractional equity orders, while whole-share market and limit orders may support OPG subject to account/routing eligibility.
impact_on_spec: Paper sizing should round to whole shares for OPG/LOO-style execution and must not assume fractional OPG support.
limitations: Some TIF values are marked with account/routing limitations; final paper activation must verify account eligibility.

claim: SEC Investor.gov states leveraged and inverse ETFs are generally designed to achieve stated objectives on a daily basis and longer-period performance can differ significantly from the stated multiple.
impact_on_spec: TQQQ exposure must be treated as high risk with explicit drawdown, gap, and volatility controls before paper_auto.
limitations: This is general investor education rather than strategy-specific risk modeling.

claim: SEC Investor.gov warns that leveraged and inverse ETFs are specialized products generally not suitable for buy-and-hold investors.
impact_on_spec: Acceptance standards must compare against TQQQ buy-and-hold and require explicit leveraged ETF risk notes before paper readiness.
limitations: Does not prohibit tactical holding, but requires the strategy to document why its holding and risk controls differ from naive buy-and-hold.
